entries.title: Psalms 61:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 61:2
segments: From the end of the earth I cry to You when my heart is faint; Lead me to the Rock higher than I.

entries.title: Psalms 61:3
segments: For You have been a shelter for me, a strong tower before the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 61:4
segments: I will dwell in Your tabernacle forever; I will trust in the hiding place of Your wings. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 61:5
segments: For You, O God, have heard my vows; You have given an inheritance to those who fear Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 61:6
segments: You will add to the days of the king's life; his years will be for many generations.

entries.title: Psalms 61:7
segments: He shall abide before God forever; prepare mercy and truth to preserve him.

entries.title: Psalms 61:8
segments: So I will sing praise to Your name forever, so that I may daily pay my vows.
